hotel_1star_room_2p.evidenceText: The returned generic Prague Expedia trend shows August $111 and states that it is based on nightly base rates for 2 adults found in the last 7 days, excluding taxes and fees. It is an all-hotel trend and does not identify the requested 1-star class.
hotel_1star_room_2p.referencePeriod: Expedia result crawled last week; generic city trend based on base rates found in the last 7 days; August monthly value.

hotel_1star_room_2p.reason: Generic all-hotel trend was rejected as class-ambiguous; no exact-city 1-star trend was returned.

hotel_3star_room_2p.evidenceText: Expedia's 3-star Prague trend table shows August $104. It explicitly says the trend excludes taxes and fees and is based on base rates for a nightly stay for 2 adults found in the last 7 days and averaged for commonly viewed properties with 3 stars in Prague.
hotel_3star_room_2p.referencePeriod: Expedia result crawled last week; trend based on base rates found in the last 7 days; August monthly value.
